Class AdocPackages

java.lang.Object
network.ike.docs.plugin.packages.AdocPackages
public final class AdocPackages extends Object
The packages layout of an AsciiDoc root (dev-adoc-packages, IKE-Network/ike-issues#1341): the first directory under the root is the owning group written as one dotted segment, network.ike.lab, and the directory under that is the topic domain, so a topic is network.ike.lab/dev/gitflow-overview.adoc and its package is network.ike.lab/dev. A library whose group ends in its only domain may use the group directory itself as the domain package: the ANF kompendium's topics are network.ike.kompendium.anf/determine-topic.adoc, in the package network.ike.kompendium.anf. META-INF is reserved for what describes the artifact; every group begins with a top-level domain, so the two never meet.

This class enumerates the packages a root holds and what each holds, the reading the manifest and the lint share.

    • packages

      public static List<AdocPackages.Package> packages(Path root, String libraryPackage) throws IOException
      Enumerate the packages of a root: for each group directory, the group itself when it holds topics directly, otherwise each subdirectory of it as <group>/<domain>, hidden directories left out. Every .adoc file under a package is parsed for its header, which is what the kind and the lint's domain rule are decided by.
      Parameters:
      root - the AsciiDoc root
      libraryPackage - the package ike.adoc.library-package names as the library's own, or null
      Returns:
      the packages in name order
      Throws:
      IOException - if the tree cannot be read
